description:
5500W Peak Motor: Delivers powerful acceleration, 75N·m torque, 28+MPH top speed, and confident climbing performance up to 35° slopes.
48V 25Ah Long-Lasting Battery: Equipped with a high-capacity battery for up to 80 miles of travel distance and 6–8 hours fast charging.
Full Shock Absorption System: Hydraulic front forks, nitrogen rear damping, and an extended sponge saddle help reduce bumps by up to 90% for a smoother ride.
Instant Hydraulic Disc Braking: Dual hydraulic disc brakes provide reliable stopping power, enhanced safety, and improved braking precision on different terrains.
All-Terrain Riding Capability: Built to handle beach roads, snow roads, mountain trails, rural roads, gravel, mud, and daily city routes with confidence.
Smart LCD Display with NFC: The clear LCD screen shows speed, battery level, distance, PAS mode, cruise mode, headlight status, and NFC unlock function.
Bright Lights for Safer Rides: Front headlight and rear brake light improve visibility during night riding, forest trails, and low-light conditions.
Comfort-Focused Design: An extended 23-inch sponge saddle, waterproof design, ergonomic handlebar controls, and 365 lbs load capacity support comfortable daily riding.
